terms.subtitle: Please review these terms carefully before using the platform.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using our storefront and affiliate dashboard, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.

responsibilities.title: 2. Affiliate Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: Affiliates are responsible for accurate lead information, transparent marketing practices, and adherence to local regulations regarding COD sales.

availability.title: 3. Product Availability
availability.content: Inventory levels and pricing may change without notice. Submitting a lead does not guarantee order fulfillment until our team confirms the request.

payment.title: 4. Payment & Commissions
payment.content: Commissions are issued after successful delivery and payment collection. Fraudulent leads may result in suspension of affiliate privileges.

changes.title: 5. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to update these terms periodically. Continued use of the platform indicates acceptance of any revisions.
